rules: Use only retrieved Opportunity, Task, Event, Quote, QuoteLineItem, OpportunityLineItem, and Contract evidence.
Use the general sales lifecycle order Qualification -> Discovery -> Quote -> Negotiation -> Closed as the organizing rubric.

Infer the evidence-backed stage from the strongest retrieved customer/opportunity work: early fit or viability work supports Qualification; need, pain-point, objective, or requirements exploration supports Discovery; proposal, quoted solution, demo, pricing presentation, or proposal follow-up supports Quote; terms, pricing bargaining, contract-term discussion, or negotiation work supports Negotiation; signed, activated, accepted, finalized, or completed contract/close evidence supports Closed.
Do not treat the current StageName as correct by default; compare it against the evidence-backed stage.
When evidence spans multiple stages, choose the furthest stage that is concretely supported by retrieved records, not a stage mentioned only as a future planned activity.
The answer must be exactly one allowed stage label or None.
Return None when the retrieved evidence supports the current opportunity StageName.
Return the corrected stage label when retrieved evidence indicates the current StageName is not appropriate.
Do not recommend updating Salesforce; only identify the correct stage label.
selected_evidence must reference retrieved evidence ids only.

schema.evidence: brief explanation grounded in retrieved opportunity records and related activity/commercial records

selected_evidence.evidence_id: retrieved Opportunity, Task, Event, Quote, QuoteLineItem, OpportunityLineItem, or Contract id used for the answer
selected_evidence.reason: why this record supports the stage judgment

fields.clarification_requirements: Opportunity ID if it is absent from the conversation
fields.target_entities: the target Opportunity.Id and any stage/task constraints stated by the user

rules: Extract the Opportunity.Id from the latest user-visible conversation when present.
Do not ask for clarification if a valid Opportunity.Id is present.
Do not write SOQL or infer stage rules in the InstanceFrame.

render_policy.answer_guidance: Return only one of: Qualification, Discovery, Quote, Negotiation, Closed, or None. No explanation.
